model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL amending Directive 2003/87/EC as regards revised benchmark values for the heat and fuel benchmarks for the period from 2026 to 2030

summary.text: This proposal aims to update the standard reference values used to measure heat and fuel efficiency under the EU's emissions trading system for the years 2026 to 2030. The revised benchmarks would establish new targets for how much heat and fuel different industries should use compared to the best performers in their sector.
